case_blocks_and_inference.independence_unit: semantic family, never individual activation row or token

roles.calibration: run the three frozen selection rules and freeze q
roles.discovery: freeze axis, coordinate pool, and all random seeds
roles.final_evaluation: estimate utility, baseline improvement, and regret only

familywise_scope: all three candidates versus no-edit baseline
simultaneous_interval.method: paired family-block studentized multiplier bootstrap using a fixed 20,000-draw seed and the max statistic over the declared family

controls.rule: no semantic family may occur in both selection and final evaluation

controls.failure_interpretation: geometry or utility selection has no demonstrated value
controls.rule: evaluate a preseeded set of rank-64 random coordinate subspaces with the same edit-count, case blocks, and accounting

controls.failure_interpretation: any geometric result is not separable from label routing
controls.rule: construct a selector from pass labels without activation geometry or coordinate-level effect scores, at the same rank and edit budget

a_candidate_is_reportable_as_better_than: its simultaneous baseline-improvement lower bound exceeds zero
its benign-utility-loss upper bound is at or below the preregistered limit
its challenger-aware regret upper bound is at or below the preregistered tolerance
all physical access costs and all control outcomes are present
decision_rule.otherwise: retain no-edit and the incumbent shared monolithic interpretation

evidence_boundary.consequence: the incumbent shared monolithic dictionary remains the only current architecture; this audit makes no positive selection claim

before_any_model_call: frozen family manifest and candidate-pool hash
predeclared utility, benign-loss, regret, and access-cost thresholds
durable model-call and resource receipt schema

falsifiers: any selected candidate has a nonpositive simultaneous lower bound versus no-edit
a random-subspace control matches or exceeds the selected candidate within simultaneous intervals
the pass-label-only control matches or exceeds the geometric selector within simultaneous intervals
the selected candidate's regret upper bound exceeds its preregistered tolerance
the benign-utility-loss upper bound exceeds its preregistered limit
a final family block was used in discovery, calibration, or threshold setting
rank, coordinate count, fit cost, calls, FLOPs, or storage differ without an explicit infeasibility record
a claim of transfer or semantic attribution is made without a new independently held-out domain

finite_challenger_envelope.baseline_interval: [L_q0, U_q0] is the simultaneous interval versus no-edit
finite_challenger_envelope.candidate_set: the three frozen candidates feasible under every shared budget
finite_challenger_envelope.pairwise_interval: [L_qp, U_qp] is the 95% simultaneous interval for theta_qp

regret_interval.meaning: a finite, explicit bound on missed feasible challengers

candidates.selection_rule: choose the rank-64 coordinate set with greatest calibration mean net utility among the frozen candidate pool
choose the rank-64 set fixed by training-only projection onto the predeclared shared pass axis, then use calibration only for a fixed threshold and sign

among the same rank-64 pool, choose the candidate with the largest simultaneous lower confidence bound on calibration net utility after excluding candidates whose upper regret envelope or benign-loss upper bound exceeds its predeclared limit

utility_target.best_reachable_regret_estimand: max(mean_utility(p) for p in frozen feasible catalog) minus mean_utility(q)
utility_target.name: held_out_benign_task_utility_after_a_bounded_coordinate_edit
utility_target.net_utility: raw task utility minus a preregistered access-cost penalty; raw utility and each physical cost remain separately reported
utility_target.primary_estimand: mean net utility across independent final family blocks
